sentences.text: However, Mr. Patil, learned Counsel appearing for the Applicant  states that the Applicant is a student of 'Sri Raghavendra Ayurveda  Medical College & Hospital', Malladihalli - 577 531, Taluka -  Holalkere, District - Chitradurga, Karnataka.

entities.text: Raghavendra Ayurveda  Medical College & Hospital', Malladihalli - 577 531, Taluka -  Holalkere
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He relied on the  Certificate issued by the Principal of the said college which is at Page  No.135.
He pointed out the theory time table for the 2 nd year B.A.M.S..

He submitted that his examination is to commence from 18.03.2024  and is till 23.03.2024.
 4.

Accordingly, the Applicant is granted temporary bail upto  26.03.2024 on the following terms and conditions:-
 ORDER (a) The Applicant - Prasad Ramesh Todkar be released on cash bail in connection with C.R. No.643 of 2023 registered with the Vadgaon Police Station, District - Kolhapur on his furnishing P.R. Bond of Rs.10,000/- with one or two sureties 503. BA 1040-2024.doc in the like amount.
(b) The Applicant is permitted to furnish cash bail surety in the sum of Rs.10,000/- in lieu of surety.
(c) The Applicant shall surrender before the jail authority on or before 26.03.2024.

5. Stand over to 27.03.2024 [First on Board].
[MADHAV J. JAMDAR, J.]
